title: JFK 2023 Release: 2,677 Indexed Records
metaDescription: BlackVaultDocs indexes 2,677 JFK Assassination Records from the 2023 NARA release, including cables and operational files — 5.1% of 52,684.
h1: JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release, 2,677 indexed files
lede: BlackVaultDocs indexes 2,677 documents from the JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release, 5.1% of a site-wide index of 52,684 documents. The files were disclosed in 2023 from the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection, including newly released cables, memoranda, and operational files. The 2,677 count is a catalog of public NARA releases indexed on this site. PDFs remain on the originating archive.

paragraphs: The 2,677 figure is the BlackVaultDocs index total for topic slug jfk-release-2023. Collection name is JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release. Each row is one indexed file from the 2023 disclosure of the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection. Page length inside a PDF does not add extra rows. A cable, a memorandum, and an operational file each increment docCount by one when they appear as separate indexed records.

Two thousand six hundred seventy-seven is 5.1% of the 52,684 documents in the site-wide index. That share is almost the same percentage as the 2025 JFK hub’s 2,706 rows, but the two hubs are different posting years and different topic slugs. Do not merge 2,677 and 2,706 into a single “early-2020s JFK” total unless you name both years; the packets publish them separately.

Agency slug is nara. No NARA ID is present in the packet facts, so none is cited here. The 2023 identity is the disclosure year plus the collection name President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection.

sections.h2: Cables, memoranda, and operational files in the 2023 posting
paragraphs: The packet description says the 2023 disclosure includes newly released cables, memoranda, and operational files. It does not give sub-counts for those three types inside the 2,677. This page therefore does not claim that most of 2,677 are operational files, or that a stated number are cables. “Including” names classes of material present in the posting.

“Newly released” in the description refers to the 2023 disclosure, not to a comparison table against 2022 or 2021. Researchers who need to see whether a title also appears in another year’s hub should open those collection pages. This overlay only has 2,677 and 52,684 as volume figures.

The 2,677 rows are not a continuation field inside the 2017–2018 or 2022 hubs. They are a separate topic. All JFK release-year hubs, together with other collections, sit under the 52,684-document site-wide index. Sorting by year on the all-collections directory is the way to keep 2023’s 2,677 attached to 2023.
The 5.1% share can move if ingest rebuilds 2,677 or 52,684. It does not move because a reader interprets an operational file differently.

This page does not treat newly released cables, memoranda, and operational files as proof of a conspiracy or as a rebuttal of any official account. The indexed fact is 2,677 public files from a 2023 NARA disclosure of the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection. Titles and scans are the record. Commentary that those files “settle” November 1963 is outside this catalog.

A title missing from the 2,677 is missing from this collection slice in the BlackVaultDocs index. It is not proof that NARA never held the file. The document index is the site-wide list for other slugs.

The JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release collection page lists the files behind 2,677. All collections shows sibling hubs. The document index is site-wide. Open the originating archive for PDFs. Cite 2,677 as this hub’s index count and 52,684 as the site-wide total, both from BlackVaultDocs’ ingest of public NARA and FOIA releases, not as NARA’s official complete JFK inventory.

The 5.1% share is 2,677 divided by 52,684. It happens to match the rounded share of the 2025 JFK hub’s 2,706 rows, but the two hubs remain different posting years. Do not add 2,677 to 2,706 and call the sum a single NARA batch.

Newly released cables, memoranda, and operational files are classes named in the 2023 description. They are not a finding that the 2023 posting was more “operational” than 2022 or 2021. This packet has no type counts to support that comparison.

Cite 2,677 with collection name JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release. Cite 52,684 as the site-wide total. If ingest is rebuilt, either number can move. PDFs remain on the originating archive. The live collection hub is the list behind 2,677. Agency tagging is nara. The document index is the site-wide list for other slugs in the 52,684-document total.

faqs.q: How many JFK 2023 release documents does BlackVaultDocs index?
faqs.a: BlackVaultDocs indexes 2,677 documents under JFK Assassination Records — 2023 Release. That is 5.1% of the 52,684 documents in the site-wide index. The files were disclosed in 2023 from the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection. PDFs remain on the originating archive.

faqs.q: What file types are in the 2023 JFK release?
faqs.a: The packet description says the 2023 disclosure includes newly released cables, memoranda, and operational files. It does not break the 2,677 rows into those three types. This page does not invent sub-counts. Agency tagging is nara. Open the collection hub and the originating archive for the scans.

faqs.q: Is the 2023 JFK release the same as the 2025 release?
faqs.a: No. The 2023 hub has 2,677 indexed documents; the 2025 hub is a different topic slug with its own count. Both sit inside the 52,684-document site-wide index. Keep the disclosure year on the citation so 2,677 stays attached to 2023.

faqs.q: Does 2,677 newly released files prove a plot in the Kennedy assassination?
faqs.a: No. The 2,677-document index is a catalog of public NARA files from the 2023 disclosure. This page does not interpret cables, memoranda, or operational files as proof of a conspiracy. Open the collection hub and the originating archive for the scans.
